tool_args.rationale: The coupled siphon-memory ODE was refuted decisively by fresh confirmation (RMSE 0.45506 versus tolerance 0.045). The available probe was already purchased, while the remaining plausible horizon- or threshold-dependent alternatives require discriminating probes that are unavailable. The observations do not support a confirmed replacement model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It has already been purchased and returned no additional rows.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed horizons are short (0.38–0.60); the needed slow_horizon_discriminating_probe is not available in the cost menu, so its long-horizon behavior is not identifiable.
No high_sgrad_regime_probe is available, and the observed s_grad values do not reach the stated supercritical range.
